- 未签名版本，需自签或使用侧载工具

### HarmonyOS（鸿蒙）
- `.hap` 文件为鸿蒙安装包
- 安装方法：通过 hdc 工具安装 `hdc install xxx.hap`，或推送到设备后用文件管理器安装
- 需在鸿蒙系统设置中允许未知来源应用安装

versions.localizedDescription:
What's New in v4.5.1

- Automatic System Language Detection: Automatically detects device and browser language on first launch via navigator.languages / navigator.language and maps to 9 supported locales (Simplified Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Tagalog, Hindi, and English fallback) (#17)
- Android Share Sheet Locale Fallback: Added native Locale.getDefault() language detection in ShareActivity.java so shared links match device language even before app initialization
- Gallery Tab Visibility Toggle: Added toggle to show or hide the Gallery tab under Settings -> Appearance (mori_show_gallery), completely bypassing background disk scans to save RAM and battery on lower-end devices
- TikTok tt.site Shortlink Recognition: Added automatic recognition and URL cleaning for TikTok tt.site shortlink domains across single downloads, batch downloads, and share activities
- Multilingual Gallery Localization: Fully localized gallery filter chips, sort options, and action toasts across all 9 supported languages
- Progressive Gallery Rendering: Implemented incremental batch rendering (24 items per batch) with IntersectionObserver sentinel for smooth, lag-free scrolling across large media collections
- O(1) History Map Indexing: Replaced linear history scans with constant-time Map indexing, prioritizing cached history thumbnails before requesting native video frame decodes
- CSS content-visibility Optimization: Applied content-visibility: auto to gallery cards to skip layout and painting of offscreen elements, significantly reducing GPU and memory overhead
- On-Demand PDF Library Loading: Converted pdf-lib and pdf.js to lazy-load on demand, eliminating heavy synchronous script tags from index.html for faster app cold start
- Android R8 & Resource Shrinking: Enabled full R8 code minification and resource shrinking in Android build.gradle with refined ProGuard rules for a leaner, smaller APK footprint
- Desktop Tauri Release Profile: Configured compiler release profile in Cargo.toml (opt-level = "z", LTO, symbol stripping, codegen-units = 1) to reduce desktop binary size and optimize runtime execution
- High-Resolution Documentation Assets: Converted all preview screenshots to crisp WebP format and added Mori CLI terminal mockups to project documentation

versions.localizedDescription:
## [2.5.2] - 2026-10-19

### English / Added
- **Check tone status button.** The current tone state can now be checked on
  demand from the home screen. The read channel is unreliable on some iOS
  releases (the AirTraffic move step never completes there), so the check
  reports one of three outcomes: silenced, originals still in place, or
  unverifiable on this device. It never runs automatically and never gates an
  operation.

### English / Changed
- After silencing, the success alert no longer claims a verified result when
  the read-back could not confirm it; it says the silence was written but
  unverified and points at the tone status check. This covers the
  [issue #6](https://github.com/LinkPass888/AirBeep/issues/6) report where the
  write channel returns success on iOS 27.x while the tones never change.

---

### 中文 / 新增
- **校验提示音状态按钮。** 可在首页按需检测当前提示音状态。部分 iOS 版本上
  读取通道不可靠（AirTraffic 搬运步骤始终无法完成），因此检测结果分为三种：
  已静音、原始提示音仍在、本机无法校验。该检测绝不自动运行，也不会阻断
  任何操作。

### 中文 / 变更
- 静音后的成功弹窗在回读校验无法确认时不再直接宣称成功，改为提示"静音
  已写入、结果未经校验"，并引导使用提示音状态校验。对应
  [issue #6](https://github.com/LinkPass888/AirBeep/issues/6) 反馈的
  iOS 27.x 上写入通道返回成功但提示音实际未变的问题。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LinkPass888/AirBeep/compare/v2.5.1...v2.5.2
